blocks.text: Once you've mastered the basics, these tricks will get you expert-level answers.
Show an example of the kind of answer you want. The AI follows an example much better than a description.
For a complex task, ask it to work step by step: "First make a plan, wait for my OK, then write."
Write: "Before you answer, ask me 3 questions that will help you give a better answer."
The first answer is a draft. Give feedback: what's good, what isn't, what to change.

I want to write a product description for an online shop. Before you start, ask me 5 questions about the product and the customers. Then write 2 versions: a short one and a detailed one. Here's an example description I like: [example].
Save prompts that work well (for example in Notes in this app) – that way you can reuse them.
In Claude you can create a "Project" with standing instructions and documents, so you don't have to explain everything every time.
In ChatGPT you can create your own GPT or a project with standing instructions for a task you do often.
In Gemini you can create a "Gem" – your own assistant with standing instructions for a specific task.
